A )cD 2.20 Match each question with two answers.Write the letters a-f. Then listen and check.
1. Don't you think it's hard shopping for gifts?
2. Do you always buy birthday cards for people?
3. Do you ever “re-gift" unwanted presents? You know, pass them on to other people?
a. I suppose I do. But I'll often just send an e-mail if it's last minute.
b. No, never. I suppose I'd worry that someone would find out!
c. Usually. I do it because I like to get lots on my own birthday, I suppose.
d. Actually, I enjoy it. Though I suppose it's not easy if you don't know what people want.
e. Sometimes. I suppose it's better than keeping something you don't want.
f. I suppose. Usually, I buy gift cards so people can choose what they want.
